thread:
rachel: quick sync request — i'm finalizing the autotune UI hooks for SLO thresholds in console. behaviour we discussed: compute proposed_threshold = ewma(p95, 24h) + alpha * rolling_std(p95, 24h). show 'proposed' with reason and allow ops to accept/reject per-org. concerns?

devin: +1 but surface confidence score and sample_count. for small tenants show a warning and default to org_threshold. also need a rollback button if alert volume spikes.

sam: Add a "simulated notify impact" preview that shows estimated fanout and percent change. For rollout, shadow-run 72h -> limited canary 24h with reduced routing_weight -> full.

rachel: draft UI fields: proposed_value, current_value, delta_pct, confidence, sample_count, apply_button, pause_autotune_toggle. show history sparkline and audit log link.

devin: telemetry panels: proposed_threshold_ts, applied_threshold_events, notify_fanout_estimate, fallback_count. emit event when fallback used.

alert-bot: scheduled shadow job autotune-preview-2026 cohort=3% start=1766610000 duration=72h. logs -> /telemetry/autotune/preview/1766610000

rachel: ok will wire up API: POST /orgs/{id}/autotune/apply with body {mode: "proposed|staged|live", routing_weight}. require audit_reason. will add apply veto that can be toggled in console.

sam: one more: rate-limit applying derived thresholds globally to avoid burst changes; config: global_apply_rate_per_minute and per-region backpressure check.

deploy-bot: shadow job queued at 1766610000, canary window 1766690000-1766693600.

rachel: thanks team — i'll update the RFC and the console mockups and push a small PR for the API contract. tagging @devin @sam for review. :thumbsup:

devin: +1

sam: +1
